plans.title: Single Body Part
plans.goal: Focus on one muscle group per session for maximum volume
plans.description: Classic single body part split dedicating each day to a distinct muscle group: Back, Legs, Arms, Shoulders, Chest, and Abs, with Sunday rest.

plans.title: Push Pull Leg
plans.goal: Balanced push, pull, and leg training twice weekly
plans.description: High-efficiency 6-day split alternating between Push (Chest/Shoulders/Triceps), Pull (Back/Biceps), and Legs, twice per week for optimal hypertrophy.

plans.title: Double Body Part
plans.goal: Dual muscle group pairing for high-volume progression
plans.description: Advanced dual-muscle split pairing Chest & Triceps, Back & Biceps, and Legs & Shoulders with high volume across 6 workout days.

plans.title: Upper Lower 4X
plans.goal: Optimal frequency with dedicated mid-week and weekend recovery
plans.description: A 4-day split alternating Lower and Upper sessions (Lower A, Upper A, Rest, Lower B, Upper B) with Wednesday, Saturday, and Sunday rest.

plans.title: Upper Lower 6X
plans.description: High-frequency 6-day routine rotating through Upper A/B/C and Lower A/B/C for experienced lifters targeting maximum density.

plans.title: 5-Day Split
plans.goal: Push / Pull / Leg followed by Upper / Lower hypertrophy
plans.description: A hybrid 5-day training system featuring Push, Pull, Legs early in the week, followed by dedicated Upper and Lower hypertrophy days.

plans.title: Full Body 3X
plans.goal: Complete full-body stimulation with ample recovery
plans.description: A 3-day full-body split (Monday Full Body A, Wednesday Full Body B, Friday Full Body C) designed for balanced development and consistency.
